title: New instrument models joined a persistent record of earlier technologies
sub: a, Share of each year’s model-labelled dataset credit assigned to selected instrument models, with equal fractional credit when a dataset names several models. Every model named in ≥50 datasets still appeared in 2025 releases; deposits include delayed releases and reanalyses. b, Effective number of models (inverse Simpson index of all fractional model shares); shading: 95% intervals from 300 bootstrap resamples of contributor groups.
